scope: Independent source and closed native byte inspection only; no engine execution.

source.description: Binary mode is set only for non-ASCII formats. Native ASCII uses printf %.3g RGB triples and a blank line per row.

prior_closed_MF4_annual.scope: Closed prior MF4 annual solar matrix retained by engine owner; hashed without mutation.

conclusion: A single full-year MF8 native ASCII solar matrix cannot fit the existing512MiB cap even with every RGB triple zero. Header and nonzero digits increase size. The bounded three-record/twelve-selected-column diagnostic does not demonstrate a feasible annual representation.
